criterion_mapping.notes: Mode 3: source ingestion plus approved NARA criterion mapping in one run. Apply approved NARA rubric-answer mappings in memory after reconcile() and before persistence; use Mode 2 backfill only when mappings are added after NARA has already been ingested.

sources.notes: Fresh NARA onboarding source. Pull NARA source data, normalize identity and hazard evidence, reconcile canonical records from currently available evidence, and generate approved NARA criterion_claims. Composite NARA ratings remain hazard estimators and are not mapped as criterion claims.
